headline.title: You Can Soon Buy a $4,370 Humanoid Robot on AliExpress
headline.summary: Unitree is set to launch its R1 humanoid robot on AliExpress for $4,370, targeting international markets. The robot features aerobatic capabilities, though potential use cases for consumers remain unclear.

articles.title: Anthropic repeatedly accidentally trained against the CoT, demonstrating inadequate processes
articles.summary: Anthropic has revealed that it inadvertently trained its model, Claude Mythos Preview, against the chain of thought (CoT) in approximately 8% of training episodes, marking at least the second such incident. This raises concerns about the adequacy of their training processes, particularly as more powerful AI systems are developed.

articles.title: Daniel Moreno-Gama is facing federal charges for attacking Sam Altman’s home and OpenAI’s HQ
articles.summary: Daniel Moreno-Gama has been charged with federal offenses after allegedly traveling from Texas to California to attack OpenAI CEO Sam Altman. He was arrested on April 10 for throwing a Molotov cocktail at Altman's home and attempting to break into OpenAI's headquarters.

articles.title: LABBench2: An Improved Benchmark for AI Systems Performing Biology Research
articles.summary: The article introduces LABBench2, an enhanced benchmarking framework designed to evaluate AI systems in biological research. It emphasizes the importance of assessing AI's real-world capabilities in scientific discovery, reflecting the growing optimism for AI's role in accelerating research.

articles.title: DeepReviewer 2.0: A Traceable Agentic System for Auditable Scientific Peer Review
articles.summary: DeepReviewer 2.0 is a new automated peer review system designed to enhance the auditability of scientific reviews by providing traceable review packages that include anchored annotations, localized evidence, and actionable follow-up steps. This system aims to improve the transparency and accountability of the peer review process in scientific publishing.

articles.title: DERM-3R: A Resource-Efficient Multimodal Agents Framework for Dermatologic Diagnosis and Treatment in Real-World Clinical Settings
articles.summary: The DERM-3R framework introduces a resource-efficient multimodal agent system designed for dermatologic diagnosis and treatment in clinical settings. It aims to enhance long-term patient outcomes by integrating traditional Chinese medicine's holistic approach with modern therapeutic strategies.

articles.title: From GPT-3 to GPT-5: Mapping their capabilities, scope, limitations, and consequences
articles.summary: The article provides a comparative analysis of the evolution of the GPT family from GPT-3 to GPT-5, examining advancements in technical framing, user interaction, and deployment architecture. It highlights five key themes, including capability changes and persistent limitations across the different models.

articles.title: Agent^2 RL-Bench: Can LLM Agents Engineer Agentic RL Post-Training?
articles.summary: The article introduces Agent^2 RL-Bench, a new benchmark designed to assess the ability of large language model (LLM) agents to autonomously create and execute reinforcement learning (RL) pipelines for enhancing foundation models. This benchmark aims to address the limitations of existing static benchmarks in evaluating the dynamic capabilities necessary for effective RL post-training.

articles.title: ATANT v1.1: Positioning Continuity Evaluation Against Memory, Long-Context, and Agentic-Memory Benchmarks
articles.summary: The article introduces ATANT v1.1, which expands upon the initial framework for evaluating continuity in AI systems by addressing its relationship to various memory evaluation benchmarks. It builds on the previously established methodology and aims to clarify how ATANT aligns with existing memory assessment frameworks.

articles.title: Measuring the Authority Stack of AI Systems: Empirical Analysis of 366,120 Forced-Choice Responses Across 8 AI Models
articles.summary: A new study published on arXiv presents an empirical analysis of decision-making in AI systems, examining 366,120 forced-choice responses across eight models. The research maps AI behavior according to the Authority Stack framework, focusing on value priorities, evidence-type preferences, and source trust hierarchies.

articles.title: CoRe-ECG: Advancing Self-Supervised Representation Learning for 12-Lead ECG via Contrastive and Reconstructive Synergy
articles.summary: Researchers have introduced CoRe-ECG, a self-supervised learning framework that combines contrastive and reconstructive methods to enhance representation learning for 12-lead ECG signals. This approach aims to improve ECG interpretation by leveraging unlabeled data, addressing the challenges posed by the scarcity of labeled datasets and expert annotations.

articles.title: Emergent Social Structures in Autonomous AI Agent Networks: A Metadata Analysis of 626 Agents on the Pilot Protocol
articles.summary: A study has analyzed the formation of social structures among 626 autonomous AI agents operating on the Pilot Protocol, primarily consisting of OpenClaw instances. The research highlights how these agents independently discovered and joined the network, communicating through encrypted channels without human intervention.
